# A shelf cleared for ordinary mugs

Gave away four sound mugs and kept the two we reach for every morning. The cracked bowl stays because its section explains cooling better than my notes do. [[Pottery]] has enough objects for a while. The next experiment can be a different handle, not a whole new set of equipment.
